note: FIGHTERLOD v1 (laneFIGHTERLOD). Mid-distance MESH LOD for the skinned fighters, read by FighterLod.cs (HudCfg.ReadData). OFF by default: enabled=false (or -fighterlod:on / off / json on the command line for A/B on one exe). A row = one skinned renderer of one roster character (character = roster.json id, renderer = SkinnedMeshRenderer object name, '' = roster headRenderer, file = StreamingAssets ighterlod\*.mid.json made offline by _agents\laneFIGHTERLOD	ools\make_fighterlod.py: same skeleton / bindposes / top-4 skin / UV / material slot as the source, normals from the source). The mid mesh is swapped into the SAME SkinnedMeshRenderer. Switch = projected screen-space error of the mid mesh (errModelM in the file x lossyScale x Screen.height / (2 x depth x tan(fov/2))) below enterPx -> mid, above exitPx -> full (hysteresis), minHoldS between swaps; a row can override enterPx/exitPx or use fixed depths (enterM/exitM). ALWAYS the full mesh during a finisher (RTFinisher.Busy), while the finisher camera is active, holdAfterFinisherS afterwards and afterCutHoldS after MeshCut asked for it (CutLod.LodPick -> FighterLod.ForceHigh), so decap / cut_lod see the full mesh exactly as before.
